title: Single-Shot Quantum Rejection Sampling Box-to-Sine Window Acceptance Law
claims: Transforming a uniform box window on {0, ..., P-1} into a target profile psi_f via a single diagonal POVM achieves maximum acceptance probability P_accept*(box -> f) = 1 / (P * max_x |psi_f(x)|^2).

For the Dirichlet-optimal sine window psi_sin*, P_accept*(box -> sin*) >= (P + 1) / (2 * P) > 1/2 for all P >= 1, strictly dominating peaked Lorentzian windows in both acceptance probability and unit-shift overlap gamma(1).
favorable_controls: Odd and even window lengths P in {7, 8, 15, 16, 31, 32}
